description.value:
Duration constant

Whenever an ally within 60 feet who can hear you critically fails a check, they may reroll it once, taking the second result. Each ally may benefit once per encounter. This costs you nothing, and you do not have to be aware the check was happening.

cinderfall.incomplete: An ally who critically fails may reroll once/encounter, at no cost to the caster. Confirmed vocabulary: no Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium, compounded by the ally-targeting default -- no selector even reaches a different creature's roll to begin with.
